notes.title: Playtests are coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/33b5372e7f7998e4b7183e7b32f4f9ae7a900d8c.png"][/img][/p][p]Originally posted on 2025.09.19[/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bigadventure.games%2Fnewsletter"]Newsletter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FGaxP5z4hjn"]Discord[/url]
[/p][/*][/list][p]There's been a lot of neat stuff happening here at Big Adventure HQ! Among our regular bug fixes and incremental improvements, there are some bigger things coming up that we'd like to share.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/7976b47379bfc378ae3c5259560806f6511df7f3.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Above: Super Supreme has been revamped![/p][p][/p][p]We've done a complete overhaul of Super Supreme's design! The world-saving giant robot now has a more action-figure-y look, something we've been calling "toy style". The colours have also been adjusted to pop better, and show the idea of two different scientists teaming up.[/p][p][/p][p]Those who have played our previous playtests know that we've been slowly bringing the toy style to various areas of our game; the settings screen and the scientist selection screen, so far. Next on the list is the most important part of the game - the encounter screen! What do you think of the game going in this direction?
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/4439d727094d727b1d8e3859397b047db95db75b.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, the next playtest will be on Steam! If you're keen to join, just head to the Steam page and click "Join the Playtest". Once the playtest starts, you'll be able to download and play it, no hassle.[/p][p]You can also invite up to 3 friends to the playtest. That way, you'll have no trouble finding a co-op partner to team up with!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/d7c164bb46f0eac142735f46c83422c714396b90.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.wellingtongamesweek.com/kiwi-games-zone" style="button"]Kiwi Games Zone NZGDC[/url]

Above: Link to the Kiwi Games Zone Open Day details.
[/p][p]In other news, we'll be at NZGDC, showing the latest build of Dream Team Supreme! We'll be there all throughout the conference, but if you don't have a ticket, you can still check out the Kiwi Games Zone on Saturday the 27th of September between 9:30am and 3:30pm. So if you're Wellington, come and say hi![/p][p]
[/p][p]That's all for now! See ya,[/p][p][/p][p]Big Adventure[/p]

notes.title: What we learned from our playtest and at gamescom
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/01d7d5db7e15f073f986de28b79b53056aae8884.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bigadventure.games%2F"]Playtest[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbigadventure.itch.io%2Fdream-team-supreme"]Demo[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bigadventure.games%2Fnewsletter"]Newsletter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FGaxP5z4hjn"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]What a fun couple of weeks. We just wrapped up the playtest and I flew back from gamescom in Germany with a ton of great feedback.[/p][p align="start"]So what did we learn?[/p][p align="start"]Splitting the powers across 3 scientists is fun! Funny data point, the pairing of Toast2 and Dr. Pierre Turner, PhD was the least picked yet the most successful haha. So if you struggled to win, maybe it's easier with Toast2 and Pierre on 0.11?[/p][p align="start"]The biggest issues that came up in the playtest were:[/p][list][*][p]Mods were offered for scientists that weren't in the pair[/p][list][*][p]Oops, that's not fun. We can address the mods by creating pools based on scientists.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The art style needs cohesion[/p][/*][*][p]The cartridge readability needs improvement[/p][list][*][p]As many of you have seen, the new scientists and the settings screen look drastically different from the rest of the game and are our first step into aligning all the visuals in a single art direction. We're calling it "toy style" and we can't wait to reveal more with each update. When we revise the cartridges in the toy style, we will also make readability improvements and will seek out your feedback to see if it solved the issues.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/f1c8297753b4f498dbb5d2d7db9f31b0afaf30e5.png"][/img][/p][p]At gamescom, we pitched the game to publishers and met fellow devs making roguelike deckbuilders. The feedback was generally positive for the same reasons you love Dream Team Supreme. The things to work on that came out from the talks are:[/p][list][*][p]Strategy isn't deep enough yet[/p][list][*][p]That's a fair assessment. We're adding depth with every cartridge, mod, and monster so looking at every 3 updates is probably a good measuring stick for how much depth we can add to Dream Team Supreme.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The art style isn't uniform[/p][list][*][p]We agree with the art style feedback and the conversion is under way. It will take several months to make it all shine in the new toy style.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hard to get players to play co-op[/p][list][*][p]What do you think about the co-op comment? We've found that at conventions, players love playing 2 player co-op. At Palmygeddon, co-op was 90% of the playthroughs. We also know that during playtests, only 5% of the playthroughs are co-op. If you have specific obstacles or features in the game that are preventing you from enjoying it in co-op, we'd love to hear your thoughts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]We've released 0.11 on itch.io so you can play it for yourself. Are the issues mentioned above also your biggest gripes or do you feel like something else is holding Dream Team Supreme back?[/p][p]
See ya,[/p][p align="start"]Olivier from Big Adventure[/p]

notes.title: Two new scientists to join Dream Team Supreme

However, 2 new scientists will try to fill Tricky Vicky's giant shoes. Their looks will be revealed in the Discord over the next two weeks so keep an eye out. I'm not making that up, I just saw the floor plan on Instagram. It's going to be wild haha.[/p][/*][*][p][b]August[/b]: I'll be at gamescom pitching Dream Team Supreme. Some of you may have taken part in those tests a little more than a year ago.[/p][/*][*][p]Freddie and I will show off Dream Team Supreme for the home crowd. We'll be in the Kiwi Games Zone, at booth 31 (one of the corner booths in the middle).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]October[/b]: We will be at PAX AUS in Melbourne. That's quite a while away, so we'll have more details closer to the date.[/p][/*][/list][p]See ya (maybe at one of these events?),[/p][p]Olivier from Big Adventure[/p]

notes.title: Join the June Playtest
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.bigadventure.games/]Playtest[/url]
[*] [url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]
[/list]

Lots happening in the Dream Team Supreme side of the world. In April, the team showcased the game at Armageddon Wellington. Thank you so much to every player who gave the game a spin! The event was a hectic blast haha; over 70 players gave it a try and filled in our survey. The showcase was during Easter weekend and we all took a week off to recover after that. When we came back, we jumped straight into addressing the feedback. Here are some of the things you liked the most about Dream Team Supreme:

[list]
[*] "I liked the co-op aspect and the somewhat complex card system"
[*] "I like the strategy element, finding the optimal synergy between the deck and how you attack and defend"
[*] "I liked how somethings came at a cost but gave back good abilities"
[*] "I loved the unique abilities of each boss"
[*] "I liked the artstyle and the variety of cards and upgrades. I'd like to play it again"
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/eb01c247e608d6d9f5f53229a28123221a315fd9.png[/img]

That was great to hear. We love these too and will keep making them better. Here's where players want the see the most improvements:

Communication on where buffs and debuffs are being applied, and general feedback to the player on how a round will play once you lock in
I sometimes was unsure about what the different abilities were/what the cards did
UI felt clunky sometimes, probably needs some animations
It feels a little slow

We feel that too. Even though we see the game everyday, we also realize that we're doing the math in our heads when we play. That's a lot to think about. We've addressed the first three points for the next build and would love to learn from you if it still feels slow, now that giants are moving and all the actions are called out when they happen in a much more direct way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/c61a1a95d4815ae00eefa1c82860b1b9ee90cadd.png[/img]

Above: Screenshots with upcoming damage and effect numbers.

We think the itch.io demo is a good proof of concept on the mechanics of the game. There's still a ton of work to do and we're excited to do it. However, the biggest missing piece now is a larger audience to validate that the world is as hungry for Dream Team Supreme as we are eager to make it awesome.

For the next phase of development, we need 3 things:
[list]
[*] more playthroughs
[*] more playthroughs per player
[*] more co-op playthroughs
[/list]
To get there, we've decided to concentrate the next run of updates into playtests. This will help us achieve a few things. Firstly, everyone playing at the same time gives us a bunch of feedback in one shot and time to act on it before the next test. Secondly, players talking to each other about their experiences brings up deep issues and opportunities to make fun things even "funner".

If you're interested in joining the first playtest in June, just go to http://wwww.bigadventure.games/ and sign up for the playtest. If you've got a friend you'd like to play with, send them to the same link to sign up. Easy haha.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/024e79599894adf32c2d96c599b5bf0040275326.png[/img]

Above: Fast friends, Gundam x Super Supreme

For a sneak peak at some of the updates, have a look at Sami and Tom play through it in our first co-op stream in the broadcast.

Stay super,

Olivier from Big Adventure

notes.title: Our biggest update
notes.notes:
[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]
[url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]

We're not kidding with that title either, we've added FIVE TIMES as much content in 0.8 compared to the amount we added in 0.7.

Here are the headlines:

[*] 5 new monsters for Super Supreme to go up against
[*] 13 new cartridges for you to add to your build
[*] 6 new mods to tip battles in Super Supreme's favor
[*] 4 new effects, one of which could make or break your next playthrough
[*] 4 new events, doubling the total that can show up each run.
[*] and last but not least, 4 new music tracks to get you in the zone as you check out the update

Enough talking about it! We understand if you want to dig in and play right now, so here's a convenient download link to take you straight to the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/1dd76ebb4e427f82dbe3df0abbfbe5b269dd2509.png[/img]

So why so much content for this update?

The answer is simple... Because we need it. 
We want Dream Team Supreme to be an engaging and replayable experience. In order to achieve that we need you to have access to a whole suite of strategic options in your playthroughs.

To do that, we added more cartridges to find in your playthroughs...
To support those cartridges, we added new status effects...
To support those status effects, we added new locations and mods...
and to test your skills with these new options, we added new monsters.

Well. What are the highlights of all this content?
[*]'Burning' is a new effect you can find on mods, cartridges and some enemy move sets. This offers you a new way to take down monsters... but careful you don't overheat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/14c2d4ebd46eec837a1bb94908820f176b501039.png[/img]

[*]There are new monsters that aim to counter scientists whose strategy relies on conserving momentum for a single powerful blow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/afb1f8b85929c1dd60c7d326817bc2c9a27086eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/477d721b830a7bb3a7ddd5c422a2b69cc390ece0.png[/img]

[*]And we added some new locations to introduce some more nuanced risk vs reward into your deckbuilding strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/6d7e37cd637bb5cb91f7a11cfa4660df7fc333a4.png[/img]

This isn't all we've been working on either!

We've still been hard at work getting touch screen and controller support ready for you. We've got all the structure in place, so hopefully it won't be long before you can try one of our updates with your favourite controller in your hand.

We're really excited about this new update and we hope you enjoy it!

Stay sharp scientists,

Tom from Big Adventure

notes.title: Enter the Maelstrom!
notes.notes:
[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]

[url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]


We're back with a small update for Dream Team Supreme, version 0.7! 

In this update, we’ve added Maelstrom – a swirling vortex of destruction that destroys anything in its path! Will you get sucked into the vortex, or will you change the forecast? Test your skills against this new giant monster and its Chaos Effect and see if you’ve got what it takes to stop it in its tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/ca37821587dfadf629b6c55ff20288dd3799ed6a.png[/img]

We've also added a new biome to explore, the tranquil hillside cliffs! It's up to Dream Team Supreme to stop the Giant monsters from ruining the serenity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/afb7bc6be093a0068ca08b570a6fb03994612a29.png[/img]

In some very exciting news...

We were selected for our first festival! Where new demos are showcased alongside up and coming games, and awesome game go on sale during the month of Ramadan. Have a look for yourself, you might like what you find

Days of Ramadan Festival 2025

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/5e6d3da4decb82bd11716ed9c7775c076f5608f0.png[/img]

In other exciting news, we're going to be exhibiting the game at the awesome Armageddon Expo! It's New Zealand's premiere comic, movie, games, TV, animation, and cosplay convention. It's on in Wellington at the Sky stadium, from the 18th to the 20th of April, 2025. Swing by the booth and say hello. Link below to grab your tickets!

Armageddon Expo - Wellington 2025

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/2087f243d948c906581f4ae9e8e4760cb27bfc41.png[/img]

The team are hard at work building more content and quality of life improvements.

We're working on touch screen and controller support, so that it's easier for us to improve the UI in the coming months while keeping all input options open. It will take a few updates before those changes come through
Our next build will have a bunch of new Giant Monsters, Cartridges, Mods and Rewards


That's all for now, we hope you have a blast with this new update! 



Stay sharp scientists,


Freddie from Big Adventure

notes.title: Peak has arrived! (initial post 2025-02-13)
notes.notes:
[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]
[url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]

We're back with another update for Dream Team Supreme, version 0.6!

In this new update, we’ve added Peak – a truly MASSIVE mountain! Will this mountain stop you in your tracks, or will you make it crumble? Test your skills against this new challenge and see if you’ve got what it takes to save the day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/59cce7eb63598fe3f84cc4f7e2eed2fcfe8a8ada.png[/img]

We've also added a new biome to explore, the frozen lands! Brave this landscape to rid the world of monsters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/fc2e93669758b88a5b5e8ff1a935cab0bd6f45cc.png[/img]

Another bit of news is we will start rolling out some onboarding newsletters for new subscribers! Even though you're already subscribed, you'll be getting these too, just a bit quicker than others - we still want to give you all the freebies and info!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/74397898616a4f369630f24c0960249bb9114268.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/f3c89afc4371a63dc1bddff75dded11ae9261627.png[/img]

Finally, there's a couple of small quality of life improvements we made.

[list]
[*] You can swap out cartridges in slots directly by just dragging a new cartridge on top, to let you reorganize your turns more smoothly.
[*] Tooltips only show up after hovering for a short amount of time instead of instantly.
[*] Solo runs no longer show the tutorial after your first time completing it, and you'll gain a mod to take out Sir Render in one hit!
[*] Added some buttons for scrolling the map, in case you don't want to use the scroll wheel.
[*] Added a button to copy the game code while hosting, as well as one to paste it when joining!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/3cafefbd55e1a14b33ad7a8eb9bb7d2dd83010bb.png[/img]

That's all for now, we hope you have a blast with this new update!

Stay sharp scientists,

Sami from Big Adventure

notes.title: Welcome to the Danger Zone! (initial post 2024-12-20)
notes.notes:
[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]
[url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]

Ho Ho Ho It's that time of year again, we released the demo of Dream Team Supreme a month ago now. Thank you to all those who played it, and thank you for your feedback. We're always keen to hear what you think is fun and what needs more cooking. 

We recently added 4 new monsters, Gridlock, Clamageddon, Giant Foot & Know It All for you to test your science skills on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/29a9fdc9aa2a0cf8faa336296a035b6f8a0029f1.png[/img]

Now all 8 of our monsters are in the game and we've added a new way for you to traverse the world of Dream Team Supreme. Welcome to the map, where maybe you'll find some exciting rewards on your journey which could help you save the day! 

[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Here is the link to download Dream Team Supreme[/url].

We're keen to see fun player choice combinations and seeing players battle all the monsters. Expect new cartridges & mods in this release to play around with. 

As always, let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/09c34c1cae863b06cc05336dc3001616eb0a878a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/48b8a6466dee3eb95c6a3651d6e7c399de777d8f.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Drop Day! (initial post 2024-11-15)
notes.notes:
[url=https://bigadventure.itch.io/dream-team-supreme]Demo[/url]
[url=https://www.bigadventure.games/newsletter]Newsletter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/GaxP5z4hjn]Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/739192b6b2cd17591de59e6c250aee0b6a11fc2a.jpg[/img]

In October, we demonstrated what we’ve been working on to the general public at PAX Australia. Players got a sneak peek of [b]Dream Team Supreme[/b]. Even though we only showed off the solo mode at PAX Aus, we received incredible feedback. 

We're so excited to share the demo with you. Here's what to expect:

[list]
[*] A roguelike deckbuilder where the players control 2 decks
[*] Solo and 2-player online co-op game modes
[*] 4 Monsters to defeat
[*] 2 Scientists and their decks to play with
[*] 40+ cards and 17 Mods to try out
[*] Lots of strategies to try out
[/list]

If you've played it at PAX, we've worked on the readability within the monster encounters and we hope that's addressed a lot of the issues from your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45264937/378ea715c605ac05927ad6a26254dc0ea66d1942.png[/img]

At this early stage of development, our goal is not to sell copies of a game that's almost finished. Quite the opposite, we're just starting out on our journey to make it the most fun roguelike deckbuilder. Our goal with the demo is to gather your feedback. We want to know what you think about it, what you like, what you don't, and any way we can make it more fun! In the game, there are links that make giving us feedback easy. We want you to join us in making [b]Dream Team Supreme[/b] as amazing as it sounds!

We plan on updating it at least once a month for the foreseeable future. Some updates will address feedback and others will focus on features we're developing.

To play with a friend or with a stranger, all you need to do is share the in-game connect code. You will need to figure out your own way to talk to each other. We suggest Discord, it's quick and easy. We also have an [url=https://discord.gg/eF8PuB4eGf]#lfg channel[/url] to make co-op games easier to find.

We can't wait to hear what you think!
